items.title: Latvia chooses Czech howitzers over Swedish Archer offer
items.snippet: Latvia will buy Czech Morana 155 mm howitzers, reversing an earlier decision to by the rival Archer artillery weapon from Sweden's BAE Systems Bofors.

items.title: The US Army is looking for new drones to ferry blood supplies
items.snippet: As part of the U.S. Army Blood Link project, the service is seeking new drones that can transport blood supplies in the field.

items.title: US Navy should target carriers in fight with China, report says
items.snippet: A U.S. think tank devised a strategy to target Chinese aircraft carriers by using similar tactics that China has planned against American ships.

items.title: Pentagon, Lockheed sign framework deal to boost AIM-260 production
items.snippet: The agreement was signed to expand production of the AIM-260 JATM, laying the groundwork for a future multiyear buy of the long-range air-to-air weapon.

items.title: US Navy awards defense startup $200 million for Blackbeard hypersonic missile
items.snippet: The U.S. Navy awarded defense startup Castelion $200 million for the production of its Blackbeard hypersonic missile.

items.title: Germany sending fighter jets to Latvia to protect election from drone incidents
items.snippet: Germany will send four Eurofighter jets to defend Latvian airspace during upcoming elections, amid concerns over drone incursions from Russia and Belarus.

items.title: Japanese Global Hawk drone splashes down in crash
items.snippet: A Japanese Global Hawk drone nosedived into the Sea of Japan this week, instantly slashing the country’s fleet of these drones by a third.

items.title: US ‘not prepared’ to respond to nuclear attacks in space, report says
items.snippet: A recent war-gaming report found that the U.S. has no tested response to a nuclear detonation in space.

items.title: US military must adapt as formations will be ‘hunted’ by autonomous systems, Caine says
items.snippet: Technology, such as AI and autonomous systems, is changing the character of war, Joint Chiefs of Staff Chairman Gen. Dan Caine said.

items.title: Germany, US to expand shared production of Patriot interceptors, strike missiles
items.snippet: German and U.S. defense leaders have signed an agreement positioning Germany as an additional production hub for scarce American defense equipment.

items.title: China warns US space weapons could fuel arms race
items.snippet: China urged the United States to halt its military build-up in outer space after Washington acknowledged it has weapons deployed in orbit.

items.title: Spain’s Indra proffers ‘Squall’ for Europe’s emerging strike missile mix
items.snippet: Spain’s Indra has launched a low-cost cruise missile it claims will cost a tenth of top-of-the line current missiles, enabling swarm tactics.

items.title: Ukraine’s Zelenskyy says new anti-drone weapon being tested
items.snippet: Zelenskyy said on Tuesday that Ukraine was carrying out tests on a new weapon to intercept drones and had recorded a successful hit overnight.

items.title: Iran war has cost $38 billion, depleted two-thirds of US missile interceptors, CBO says
items.snippet: The U.S. military has incurred about $38 billion in costs from combat operations against Iran, a new Congressional Budget Office analysis found.

items.title: Iranian strikes damaged hundreds of US military buildings, dozens of aircraft
items.snippet: Iranian strikes have damaged hundreds of U.S. military and diplomatic buildings, as well as dozens of aircraft, a Pentagon watchdog said.
